failureMessage: baselining lands a seeded pack on every member but is gated !isHome, so a newly seeded pack reaches the whole fleet except this repo, invisibly

requireIndexCoverage.what: the "{pack}" pack flags seededByDefault (packs/{pack}/pack.mjs) but is not declared here
requireIndexCoverage.fix: add "{pack}" to the "packs" array — baselining skips the home, so this repo's declaration is hand-maintained; a deliberate opt-out is an acceptance with a reason instead

failureMessage: a legacy tolerance nobody is scheduled to remove is a permanent feature wearing a temporary name, and its holders are never told to move off it

matchLines.what: {match} declares a legacy tolerance with no scheduled removal above it
matchLines.fix: put `// @legacy-tolerance advisory:<rule-id|none> retire:#<issue>` directly above it: the rule that tells a holder to migrate, and the issue whose merge deletes this code

matchLines.what: {match} is not a readable tolerance annotation
matchLines.fix: write it as `// @legacy-tolerance advisory:<rule-id|none> retire:#<issue>` with nothing after — a grep for this token is the register, and an unparseable form is not in it

failureMessage: a pack's RULES.md is written several times a day, and a whole-file re-apply onto a moved main deletes lessons with nothing going red

forbidRemovedLinesMatching.fix: re-apply your edit onto the fetched file as an insertion, and say in the PR when a rule is deliberately retired
